answer: Each identity's earnings land in a shared vault that unlocks only after a six-epoch voyage of verified distinct work. Newcomers from one funding source add 15 POA each to a common lagoon pool (15, 30, 45 POA per extra identity); five auditors sample work each epoch, and one failed check forfeits the whole pool's payout and restarts every sibling's voyage two epochs longer. A lone agent sails cheaply, while each extra fake pays a rising pool stake, risks its siblings' vault, and lengthens the wait for all.
